gen-gf-unkempt-gf-tenor-sans: Tenor Sans reads light but not faint, its plain sans letters keeping a gentle stroke variation and c tips that never touch. Unkempt supplies the muscle, flat and commanding, against that lighter hand.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-varta: Varta opens every e and a into a wide eye, its plain sans build staying modern and unfussy beside loud company. Unkempt's ruler-straight, constant-width line is the standout quality here.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ysabeau-infant: Approachable and contemporary, Ysabeau Infant flicks its terminals outward like tongs beneath Unkempt's ruler-straight, expressive lettering up top. Loud heading, friendly body: one grabs attention, the other keeps it.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpan: Zalando Sans SemiExpanded is modern and open-mouthed in its curves. Unkempt cuts every stroke to a single width, expressive and commanding, and loses its punch if shrunk small.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Flat, commanding shouting from Unkempt, with no stroke shift at all. ZCOOL XiaoWei then reads smoothly across a whole paragraph, its stems carrying a slight but clear modulation.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-cal-sans: Bold, commanding Wallpoet lets paper show through between its own letters. Cal Sans keeps a single stroke width and a tall x-height, so a paragraph reads approachably and smoothly.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-changa: Paper shows through the gaps between Wallpoet's letters, a bold, commanding look, while Changa brings modern, clean sans-serif lowercase. Give Wallpoet the large sizes and let Changa handle the smaller text.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-courier-prime: Wallpoet lets paper show through its bold, commanding letters, while Courier Prime types out a precise monospace line with generous round mouths. Reading it feels structured, like a drafted page.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-geom: Loud, gapped and bold, Wallpoet sits beside Geom, a contemporary, approachable sans with a lofty lowercase band. Wallpoet earns its keep when it is big and short, commanding a line.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-mukta-malar: Bold paper-gapped lettering from Wallpoet meets Mukta Malar, a neutral, approachable sans with compressed ascender length. Give Mukta Malar a little extra size to offset its compact ascenders.
